Probes.Title: Additional mass-parameter check
Probes.Note: The original passing tables above are retained at their recorded inputs. This saved formula fails an additional mass assignment: setting the muon mass equal to the electron mass gives failures at two Z poles and in the independent Feynman comparison. It is not certified for arbitrary masses. The check below changes only the numerical parameter rules; the amplitude and particle labels are unchanged.
Probes.InputTemplate:
$CASEParameterProbeChannels = FactorizationAmplitudeChannels[
  $CASEParticles, smFactorization];
$CASEParameterProbeFeynman = FeynmanToSpinorProducts[
  DiagramAmplitudes[CreateDiagrams[$CASEParticles, smFeynman]],
  "ReferenceSpinors" -> Automatic, "ReduceSpinorProducts" -> False,
  "TimeConstraint" -> 30];
$CASEParameterProbe = CheckAmplitudes[
  $CASEAmplitude, $CASEParameterProbeChannels, smFactorization,
  "FeynmanAmplitudes" -> $CASEParameterProbeFeynman,
  "FeynmanModel" -> smFeynman, "ParameterRules" -> $PARAMETER_RULES,
  "RandomSeed" -> $RANDOM_SEED, "TimeConstraint" -> $CHECK_SECONDS,
  "Output" -> "Details"];
$CASEParameterProbe["Table"]
